profile.jobTitle: Full-Stack Software Engineer | XAML UI Specialist | WPF Developer | Finance Technology
profile.summary:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with 13+ years of experience delivering and modernizing enterprise-grade applications across highly regulated and performance-critical industries. 

My core expertise is .NET (C#) with a primary specialization in XAML-based UI development, including WPF, WinUI, UWP, MAUI, and related XAML frameworks, where I focus on building scalable, maintainable, and high-performance desktop experiences.

I specialize in rich client applications, UI architecture, and interaction models, with a strong emphasis on MVVM, modular design, accessibility, performance optimization, and long-term maintainability. I have led and contributed to the modernization of legacy desktop systems, transforming complex, monolithic solutions into clean, extensible platforms with improved UX, reduced TCO, and higher developer productivity.

Beyond desktop, I bring solid experience in Web Development, integrating web technologies into native applications and building full-stack solutions using JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, ASP.NET, Razor, and modern browser-based components (including WebView-based integrations). I am comfortable bridging native and web worlds, designing secure communication layers, shared models, and hybrid UI strategies.

My background includes deep exposure to Cybersecurity-aware environments, access control systems, role-based authorization, identity management, secure data handling, and compliance-driven architectures; particularly relevant to finance, media, and large-scale enterprise ecosystems.

I have worked across multiple industries, including Financial Services, FinTech, Banking, Capital Markets, Media & Entertainment, Retail, Sports Technology, and Enterprise Software, collaborating with global, cross-functional teams. My professional experience spans North America, Latin America, and international markets, contributing to projects and organizations operating in the United States, Mexico, and other global hubs.

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer | XAML UI Specialist | WPF Developer | Finance Technology
positions.description:
Working as a Full-Stack Software Engineer focused on the design, modernization, and evolution of mission-critical trading and financial platforms used by internal teams and business stakeholders.

My role is centered on building robust, maintainable, and high-performance desktop and backend solutions, balancing technical excellence with real-world financial constraints such as reliability, security, scalability, and cost efficiency.

Key Responsibilities & Contributions:

● Design and implement desktop applications and internal tools using C#, .NET, and XAML-based technologies, emphasizing clean architecture, MVVM patterns, and long-term maintainability.

● Contribute to the modernization of legacy trading systems, reducing technical debt and improving system clarity without disrupting existing business workflows.

● Collaborate closely with business, trading, and technical stakeholders to translate complex financial requirements into clear, reliable, and scalable software solutions.

● Focus on performance optimization, ensuring applications could handle real-time data interactions and high-pressure trading scenarios.

● Support ongoing system evolution by improving code readability, modularity, and ownership, enabling teams to confidently extend and maintain the platform.

Impact & Results:

● Improved system stability and developer productivity by simplifying complex legacy components.

● Reduced long-term maintenance costs by promoting cleaner architecture and reusable components.

● Delivered solutions that balanced technical rigor with business practicality, a key requirement in trading and financial environments.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · WPF · XAML · .NET · FIX Protocol · C++ · User Experience (UX) · gRPC · UI Automation · Telerik · DevExpress · Xceed · Prism · TypeScript · Copilot · AI · JavaScript · HTML

positions.description:
● Analyzed business and user requirements to design and deliver scalable software solutions aligned with enterprise needs.

● Designed, developed, and released reusable software components, contributing to faster delivery cycles and improved system maintainability.

● Developed .NET Framework and .NET Core services to extend and modernize legacy backend systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer | XAML UI Specialist | .NET C# Developer | UWP Developer | MAUI Developer
positions.description:
Led the redesign and modernization of a legacy Windows POS platform for the fast-casual food industry, transforming an aging system into a responsive, touch-first experience built on the UWP XAML engine.

By re-architecting UI flows, optimizing memory usage, and applying asynchronous and multi-threaded patterns, the platform achieved measurable improvements in runtime performance, resource efficiency, and overall system stability; critical for high-throughput, always-on retail environments.

This experience reinforced a core principle: modern UX is not just visual refinement, but the result of intentional performance engineering applied to real-world, high-volume systems.
positions.insights: Skills: UWP · C# · XAML · WPF · REST APIs · MAUI · SQLite · .NET · MongoDB · Prism · ASP.NET Web API

positions.title: Software Engineer | .NET C# Developer | WPF Developer | Web Developer | SQL Developer
positions.description:
Worked across finance, insurance, and sports entertainment environments, delivering enterprise-grade desktop and web platforms designed for scale, security, and long-term maintainability.

Contributed to the design and evolution of hybrid architectures combining WPF desktop applications with web-based modules, enabling consistent UX and faster iteration across products. Applied MVVM and component-based design to keep UI layers clean, testable, and extensible.

Built and maintained interactive web interfaces using TypeScript, JavaScript, Vue.js, HTML, CSS, and LESS, focusing on modular UI composition and clarity under complex business rules. Developed backend features using ASP.NET and Razor, integrating RESTful APIs to support secure, data-driven workflows.

Worked with SQL-based databases, ensuring reliable data access, integrity, and performance across enterprise use cases. Implemented role-based access controls, secure form handling, and controlled user provisioning, aligned with compliance and audit requirements in regulated industries.

Optimized UI responsiveness and performance for data-intensive and near real-time scenarios, including high-visibility operational and sports environments. Collaborated closely with designers, backend teams, and client stakeholders, acting as a technical reference for WPF/XAML and enterprise web UI best practices.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · HTML · JavaScript · MVC · Node.js · Vue.js · W3C Accessibility · jQuery · Angular · WPF · XAML · UWP · SQL Server · Azure Functions · Entity Framework · SQL

positions.title: Software Engineer | .NET - C# Developer | Web Developer | SQL Developer | WPF Developer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
As a Staff Augmentation Software Engineer from Globant, I contributed to a large-scale financial analytics platform supporting stockholders with real-time and historical market insights. While the product ecosystem included web applications built with ASP.NET and Vue.js, my primary focus was the design and development of a custom charting and data-visualization engine built in XAML and WPF.

This engine processed and rendered complex, high-volume financial datasets retrieved from SQL-based systems and multiple market data providers, enabling clear, performant, and interactive visual analysis. Emphasis was placed on rendering performance, memory efficiency, and UI responsiveness, ensuring accurate and fluid visualization under continuous market activity.

This experience reinforced the value of native XAML rendering as a strategic advantage for financial platforms where precision, speed, and visual clarity directly impact decision-making.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · C# · WPF · XAML · SQL Server · JavaScript · ASP.NET MVC · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · LESS (Stylesheet Language) · HTML · Razor · W3C Accessibility

positions.title: Software Engineer | .NET - C# Developer | UWP Developer | XAML Developer
positions.description:
As a Staff Augmentation Software Engineer from Globant, I contributed to the design and development of a UWP XAML application targeting both Microsoft Surface devices and desktop environments, built entirely on the Microsoft ecosystem. The platform supported next-generation baseball scouting and team management by aggregating and exposing large volumes of professional and collegiate player data.

The UWP interface enabled managers, coaches, and directors to explore, configure, and act on complex datasets through clear, touch-optimized, and responsive XAML-based views. Built on top of Azure Functions and delivered through Azure DevOps pipelines, the solution emphasized performance, usability, and scalability in a real-world, decision-critical environment.

This experience was rich collaboration with Microsoft that reinforced the power of UWP XAML as a robust foundation for data-intensive applications that demand precision, mobility, and modern UX at scale.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · XAML · UWP · .NET · Azure Functions · Prism

positions.title: Software Engineer | .NET - C# Developer | Web Developer | SQL Developer | WPF Developer
positions.locationName: Newark, New Jersey, United States · Remote
positions.description:
As a Staff Augmentation Software Engineer from Globant, I contributed to a large-scale financial web platform focused on the generation of investment fund reports. While the application ecosystem included ASP.NET-based web solutions, my primary responsibility was the design and development of a custom financial reporting and charting engine built with WPF and XAML.

The engine processed complex SQL-driven data models and rendered structured financial reports through reusable C# services and libraries. Emphasis was placed on data accuracy, rendering performance, and maintainable UI architecture, ensuring reliable and consistent reporting across highly regulated investment environments.

This experience reinforced the role of WPF XAML as a strategic layer for precise, high-fidelity financial visualization and reporting systems.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Core · C# · HTML · JavaScript · MVC · Microsoft SQL Server · Vue.js · jQuery · W3C Accessibility

positions.title: Software Engineer | .NET - C# Developer | WPF Developer | SQL Developer
positions.description:
As a Staff Augmentation Software Engineer from Code Ingenieria SA de CV, I contributed to the design, development, and support of a large-scale WPF XAML–based POS platform supporting end-to-end pharmaceutical operations, including point of sale, online sales, billing, inventory management, logistics, and purchasing workflows.

The platform was continuously evolved through the implementation of new systems and features, with a strong focus on performance optimization, business process automation, security, and modern user experience. Operating in a mission-critical healthcare environment, the solution emphasized stability, clarity, and scalability across high-volume daily transactions.

This experience reinforced the importance of robust WPF architectures as the backbone of reliable, secure, and user-centered enterprise systems.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · XAML · WPF · Microsoft SQL Server · Entity Framework · C# · WCF · SQL Server · SQL

positions.title: Software Engineer | PwC Associate | Cybersecurity Developer | Web Developer | SQL Developer
positions.description:
Worked on enterprise initiatives across media, retail, and financial services, contributing to the modernization and hardening of mission-critical desktop and web systems operating under strict security and access-control requirements.

Developed web components and internal tools using Novel IdM accelerating capabilities by integrating JavaScript, HTML, CSS, supporting secure workflows and operational use cases. Built and maintained forms and UI flows for role-based access management, enabling controlled provisioning and administration of enterprise users.

Implemented and automated user account management backed by SQL databases, ensuring secure data handling, integrity, and traceability. Contributed to access control mechanisms aligned with cybersecurity and auditability standards, particularly relevant in financial and high-trust environments.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams and client stakeholders to translate operational and security requirements into robust technical solutions, balancing usability with compliance.
positions.insights: Skills: Cyber Security Risk · JavaScript · HTML · Identity Management · Oracle Database · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Software Engineer | Cybersecurity Developer | Web Developer | SQL Developer
positions.description:
As a Staff Augmentation Software Engineer from PwC, I participated in the deployment of a centralized identity and role management framework for a large retail organization, consolidating distributed identities into a governed security model using Novell technologies.

Built web-based administration forms using HTML and JavaScript to handle role assignment and access control, and implemented automation for SQL-based user account management, strengthening security, traceability, and operational efficiency across transactional retail systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Cyber Security Risk · JavaScript · HTML · SQL · Oracle Database · Novell Identity Manager

positions.title: Software Engineer | Cybersecurity Developer | Web Developer | SQL Developer
positions.description:
As a Staff Augmentation Software Engineer from PwC, I contributed to the implementation of a centralized identity and access management architecture for a large media organization, unifying user identities across multiple Oracle and SQL Server systems using Novell Identity Management.

Developed HTML and JavaScript–based web forms to manage role-based access and identity workflows, along with automation processes for SQL-hosted user accounts, enabling controlled provisioning, updates, and revocation of access across broadcast, production, and corporate platforms.
positions.insights: Skills: Cyber Security Risk · JavaScript · HTML · SQL · Oracle Database · SQL Server · Novell Identity Manager

positions.title: Software Engineer | .NET C# Developer | WPF Developer | SQL Developer
positions.description:
Led the modernization of a legacy ERP system, migrating a large-scale application from WinForms to WPF, leveraging the DevExpress framework to standardize UI components and improve overall usability and maintainability.

During the core build phase, I designed and developed new ERP modules in C#, applying solid software engineering practices such as modular design, clear separation of concerns, and maintainable architecture patterns to ensure long-term scalability.

On the data layer, I was responsible for designing and implementing new SQL Server database objects, including tables, relationships, and supporting structures aligned with the evolving business logic of the system.

Additionally, I produced technical and UI documentation to support system adoption, facilitate onboarding, and ensure long-term knowledge transfer for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · WPF · XAML · WinForms · SQL · DevExpress · Visual Basic · ADO.NET · SQL Server
